definitions.gloss: sidelong glance; looking out of the corner of one's eye
definitions.explanation: The act of looking at something or someone from the side without turning one's head, often implying suspicion, jealousy, or discreet observation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{横目|よこめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I glanced at her out of the corner of my eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{横目|よこめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not peek at your neighbor's test from the corner of your eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{騒|さわ}ぎ→騒ぎ：02827_sawagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{横目|よこめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{黙々|もくもく}→黙々：14712_mokumoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: Paying no attention to the commotion around him, he silently continued working.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the patterns {横目|よこめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to glance sideways at) and {横目|よこめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (while ignoring; with a sidelong glance at). The pattern ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{横目|よこめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ means to observe something peripherally while focusing on something else, often implying indifference.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横目|よこめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look at sideways)
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{横目|よこめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (paying no attention to ~; while glancing at ~)
- {横目|よこめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use a sidelong glance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {流|なが}し{目|め}: a lingering sidelong glance — often flirtatious
- ちらっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to take a quick peek — briefer and less deliberate
- にらむ: to glare at — hostile and direct, not sideways
